query: Rear-ended at a stop light this morning. Minor bumper damage, other driver has insurance and admitted fault. No injuries.
Windshield cracked by a rock kicked up on the highway. Driving home now, no other damage.
Front-end collision at 35 mph. Airbag deployed. Driver reports neck pain and is going to urgent care. Vehicle likely a total loss.
Vehicle rolled multiple times after brake failure on a mountain road. Driver airlifted to hospital, passenger unconscious at scene.
Car stolen from parking lot overnight. Police report filed this morning. Insured wants a rental within the hour.
Same insured filed three collision claims this quarter, all single-vehicle, all reported after business hours, always with the same tow shop.
Insured reports total loss but photos show only cosmetic damage. Repair estimate they submitted is 4x the shop's quoted labor rate.
Tree fell on parked vehicle during a windstorm. Extensive roof damage. Insured has photos and a witness. Vehicle drivable.
Hit-and-run in a grocery store parking lot. No witnesses, no camera footage yet. Dent on driver-side rear door.
Multi-vehicle pileup on the interstate in fog. Six cars involved, two occupants transported by ambulance, one fatality confirmed.
